title: AesCode: Aesthetic Code Generation with Decoupled Cross-Modal Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2610.18860v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generating information-rich visual artifacts such as slides, posters, and dashboards as code is appealing because the outputs are structured, editable, and verifiable. Yet code models cannot see how their choices of layout and color come together on the canvas, often limiting spatial planning and aesthetic quality. Image generators excel at visual design but can misrender requested content, making their outputs unreliable targets for direct reproduction. We therefore introduce AesCode, which generates code grounded in the content prompt while using an image generated from the same prompt as an aesthetic guidance. To do so, AesCode represents the target as a design graph that describes the whole canvas and makes each property attributable. From this graph, we derive complementary cross-modal rewards: deterministic verifiers score properties parsable from code and rendering, while a VLM judge assesses the non-parsable ones with a sample-sp

translated_title: AesCode：基于解耦跨模态奖励的美学代码生成
translated_abstract: 以代码形式生成幻灯片、海报和仪表板等信息丰富的视觉作品极具吸引力，因为其输出具有结构化、可编辑和可验证的特点。然而，代码模型无法直观看到其布局与颜色选择在画布上的组合效果，这往往限制了空间规划能力和美学质量。图像生成器擅长视觉设计，但可能会错误渲染所请求的内容，使其输出无法作为直接复现的可靠目标。因此，我们提出了AesCode，它基于内容提示生成代码，同时使用由相同提示生成的图像作为美学引导。为此，AesCode将目标表示为一个设计图，该设计图描述整个画布并使每个属性可归因。基于该设计图，我们推导出互补的跨模态奖励：确定性验证器对可从代码和渲染中解析的属性进行评分，而视觉语言模型（VLM）裁判则通过采样评估不可解析的属性。
tldr: AesCode通过设计图表示和融合确定性验证器与VLM裁判的解耦跨模态奖励，以图像生成的美学引导来生成兼具内容准确性与美学质量的视觉作品代码。
en_tdlr: AesCode generates aesthetic code by leveraging image generation as aesthetic guidance, using a design graph representation with decoupled cross-modal rewards that combine deterministic verifiers with a VLM judge to achieve both content fidelity and aesthetic quality.
